title: Frobenius-semilinear vector-bundle fixed points
statement:
Let $p$ be a prime and $S$ a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) [def-pc-scheme] over $\mathbf F_p$. Let $E$ be an $\mathcal O_S$-module which Zariski-locally is isomorphic to $\mathcal O_S^{\oplus r}$ for some finite $r\geq0$, and view $E_{\mathrm{et}}$ as an abelian sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] in the chosen coefficient universe. If sectionwise $\operatorname{ULift}$ is used, transport addition and scalar action along its bijection, and use the same lift for $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}$. Let $F:E_{\mathrm{et}}\to E_{\mathrm{et}}$ be an additive sheaf morphism satisfying $F(ae)=a^pF(e)$ for every pair of local sections $a$ of $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}$ and $e$ of $E_{\mathrm{et}}$. With kernel and cokernel in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves],
$$\operatorname{Coker}(F-1)=0,\qquad\operatorname{Ker}(F-1)\text{ is constructible}$$
in the finite abelian stratum sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-sheaf]. Neither invertibility of $F$ nor constant rank on all of $S$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0GKU, label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb; Noetherian specialization of both conclusions

proof.text: Use the local-lift theorem to show F-1 is locally surjective on the small etale site. The abelian sheaf local-surjectivity criterion makes it an epimorphism, so its categorical cokernel is zero.

source.place: Tag 0GKU, label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb; Noetherian specialization of both conclusions

proof.text: Use the affine kernel-model theorem to obtain finitely many affine opens W_a covering S, and affine etale P_a→W_a representing the underlying set sheaf of the inverse image of K=ker(F-1). Local Noetherianness makes S quasi-separated.

source.place: Tag 0GKU, label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb; Noetherian specialization of both conclusions

proof.text: On each chart stratify the affine etale map P_a→W_a into finitely many constructible locally closed immersed strata over which its base change is finite. Inverse image of the represented set sheaf is represented by that base change, and commutes with the underlying-set functor of abelian sheaves. Thus the restricted K has a finite etale representing object.

source.place: Tag 0GKU, label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb; Noetherian specialization of both conclusions

proof.text: The finite-etale Yoneda local-trivialization theorem makes the represented set sheaf locally constant with finite stalks. Transport this property across the isomorphisms above. Isomorphism transport uses the existing finiteLocallyConstant_of_iso theorem from PullbackFiniteLocallyConstant, without duplicating its proof.

source.place: Tag 0GKU, label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb; Noetherian specialization of both conclusions

proof.text: Apply the global stratification gluing core to the finite affine cover and the finite chart stratifications. Each resulting stratum factors through one of the local strata. Pullback of finite local constancy along this factorization is the already stated pullback theorem, which packages composition, base change of covers, pullback of constant sheaves, and finite-stalk transport.

source.place: Tag 0GKU, label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb; Noetherian specialization of both conclusions

proof.text: Apply the finite-local-abelian-forget equivalence on each global stratum to get local constancy as an abelian sheaf. Discard empty members of a constant trivializing cover. On each remaining member choose an algebraically closed geometric point; the constant value is isomorphic to its stalk and hence finite, since the underlying set sheaf has finite stalks. Restriction along each etale cover map agrees with upperStar, and yields the precise finite abelian constant models required by the constructibility definition.

lean.statement:
theorem frobenius_vectorBundle_kernel_constructible
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [S.Over (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod p))))] [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (E : S.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (F : (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E) ⟶
      (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E))
    (hF : ∀ (U : S.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
        (e : ULift.{u + 1} Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)),
      F.hom.app U (ULift.up (a.down • e.down)) =
        ULift.up (a.down ^ p • (@id Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)
          (F.hom.app U e).down))) :
    IsZero (cokernel (F - 𝟙 _)) ∧
      IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf (kernel (F - 𝟙 _))
